_comment: Expansion 3 part E.7: spells outside battle - great magic (docs/expansions/03-demigods-magics.md). Numbers from the 2024 Player's Handbook. Done in game/greatmagic.py (road ops 'contingency', 'jar', 'clone', 'imprison'; Wish's other uses are its road_too 'wish'), with the fight's side in rules/combat.py.

contingency.name: Contingency

material.text: a gem-encrusted statuette of yourself worth 1,500+ GP

contingency.text: For ten days a spell of level 5 or lower waits on you, its slot spent, until the moment you chose: as a fight begins, when you are brought below half your hit points, or when you fall. Then it takes effect on you at once, without an action.

magic_jar.name: Magic Jar

material.text: a gem, crystal or reliquary worth 500+ GP, which holds your soul and shatters when the spell ends

magic_jar.text: Your soul leaves your body for a gem. In a fight your body lies still, and your soul may leap 100 feet into a humanoid foe (a Charisma save) and fight with its body for you, or go back to your own.

simulacrum.name: Simulacrum

material.text: powdered ruby worth 1,500+ GP, which the spell consumes

simulacrum.text: Twelve hours turn a heap of snow into the likeness of one of the party, a beast of your herd or a prisoner: a construct with half its hit points that fights at your side. Only a repair at a long rest mends it (100 GP a hit point); at 0 it melts. A new one unmakes the old.

clone.name: Clone

material.text: a diamond worth 1,000+ GP, which the spell consumes, and a sealable vessel worth 2,000+ GP

clone.text: A duplicate of someone of the party grows in a sealed vessel in a temple's crypt for 120 days. If they die after that, their soul wakes in it, whole, with nothing of what they carried.

imprisonment.name: Imprisonment

material.text: a statuette of the target worth 5,000+ GP

imprisonment.text: When a band on the road is seen first, the strongest of it is bound for good (a Wisdom save): buried, chained, hedged in, shut in a gem or asleep for ever.
